topic: Natural Objects in the Sky Day and Night
key_concepts: The sun is seen in the daytime sky
Rainbows are seen in the daytime sky
Stars are seen in the nighttime sky
The moon is seen in the nighttime sky
Clouds can be seen in both daytime and nighttime
The sun is the source of light
The sun is the source of heat
The moon and stars are usually seen at night
Some activities are done during the day because it is brighter
